# apipbx_parking_lot (Resource)

A tenant's call parking lot. Import with the tenant id.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `first_slot` (Number) The first slot number; dialling a slot picks up the call parked there.
- `park_number` (String) Dial it to park a call. Reserved: no other number of the tenant can be the same.
- `slots` (Number) How many slots (1-100).
- `tenant_id` (String) One lot per tenant.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
